text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The new road tax will become effective August 1.
- The new government issued in six months more decrees than the former leftist cabinet did in four years.
- Businessmen need 21 days to register a new company in Romania.
- The government decided to give Romanian wheat producers subsidies amounting to 150,000 per tonne of wheat, in a bid to encourage exports, the paper says.
- The government decided to guarantee a $30 million credit needed by the Brasov-based Tractorul SA tractor maker to buy raw materials.
- Bad weather affected some 487,000 hectares over June 18- July 16, the paper says.
- The Dacia Automobile car maker in Pitesti might be listed on the Bucharest stock exchange, the paper says.
